final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT client.district_id AS district_id, district.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client JOIN district ON district.district_id = client.district_id GROUP BY client.district_id, district.A3), region_totals AS (SELECT region, SUM(client_count) AS region_count FROM district_counts GROUP BY region), ratios AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.region, d.client_count, 1.0 * d.client_count / r.region_count AS ratio FROM district_counts AS d JOIN region_totals AS r ON d.region = r.region), ratio_total AS (SELECT SUM(ratio) AS total FROM ratios) SELECT ratios.district_id, ratios.region, ratios.client_count, ratios.ratio, 1.0 * ratios.client_count / ratio_total.total AS final_ratio FROM ratios CROSS JOIN ratio_total ORDER BY final_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
